templates.label: Long-form YouTube
templates.description: Plan, edit, review, and package a complete long-form YouTube production.

guide_stages.label: Define the production
guide_stages.detail: Confirm the audience, purpose, format, sources, and delivery goal.
guide_stages.prompt: Review this workflow's brief and bound sources, then identify any missing intake decisions.

guide_stages.label: Understand the source
guide_stages.detail: Map the argument, demonstrations, beats, conclusion, and timing uncertainty.
guide_stages.prompt: Analyze this workflow's bound sources and establish the required source-understanding artifacts.

guide_stages.label: Plan the edit
guide_stages.detail: Choose cuts and audiovisual treatments for explicit editorial reasons.
guide_stages.prompt: Draft the editorial strategy for this workflow and a representative preview plan.

guide_stages.label: Build and review revisions
guide_stages.detail: Execute the reviewed plan, preserve versions, and address bound feedback.
guide_stages.prompt: Continue this workflow's reviewed edit and report the resulting revision and evidence.

guide_stages.label: Complete final QA
guide_stages.detail: Review the actual delivery with audio and keep publication approval separate.
guide_stages.prompt: Assess final QA for this workflow without claiming any review that has not occurred.

templates.label: Solo podcast
templates.description: Produce a one-speaker audio-first podcast with optional camera video and supporting visuals.

guide_stages.label: Set the episode brief
guide_stages.detail: Choose the canonical audio, optional camera, audience, identity, and visual density.
guide_stages.prompt: Review the solo podcast brief and verify one canonical audio source plus any optional camera selection.

guide_stages.label: Map the episode
guide_stages.detail: Identify chapters, key moments, claims, and transcript uncertainty from the bound episode.
guide_stages.prompt: Create source understanding and an episode map for this solo podcast workflow.

guide_stages.label: Plan the visual score
guide_stages.detail: Plan waveform branding and purposeful chapter visuals without a fixed effects quota.
guide_stages.prompt: Prepare a transcript-bound visual strategy for this solo podcast workflow.

guide_stages.label: Render and review the episode
guide_stages.detail: Build the selected waveform, camera, and accepted visual treatments.
guide_stages.prompt: Render or revise the reviewed solo podcast stage and preserve its provenance.

guide_stages.label: Qualify the long-form episode
guide_stages.detail: Check the complete 25–45 minute delivery, audio, visuals, and review evidence.
guide_stages.prompt: Assess podcast qualification and list any listening, visual, or owner review still pending.

templates.label: Short-form video
templates.description: Create a deliberate vertical adaptation bound to a reviewed source or revision.

guide_stages.label: Define the short
guide_stages.detail: Choose the source, audience, platform contract, and intended takeaway.
guide_stages.prompt: Review the short-form brief and bound source without inheriting unrelated platform assumptions.

guide_stages.label: Find the complete beat
guide_stages.detail: Identify a self-contained claim, demonstration, or story with trustworthy timing.
guide_stages.prompt: Map the source segment proposed for this short-form workflow and preserve necessary context.

guide_stages.label: Plan the vertical adaptation
guide_stages.detail: Recompose framing, captions, attention, and pacing for the selected format.
guide_stages.prompt: Plan a deliberate vertical adaptation rather than an automatic center crop.

guide_stages.label: Build the short revision
guide_stages.detail: Create and inspect the bound short-form output and its transitions.
guide_stages.prompt: Build or revise this short-form output and preserve its relationship to the reviewed source.

guide_stages.label: Review the short in context
guide_stages.detail: Check the full vertical output, safe areas, captions, sound, and packaging truthfulness.
guide_stages.prompt: Perform available short-form QA and identify every review still pending.

templates.label: Clean audio
templates.description: Improve intelligibility while preserving the source voice and validating cleanup fidelity.

guide_stages.label: Choose the audio problem
guide_stages.detail: Bind the source and describe the noise, intelligibility issue, and intended output.
guide_stages.prompt: Inspect the bound audio source and define the cleanup goal without assuming a provider.

guide_stages.label: Establish the audio baseline
guide_stages.detail: Document channels, sample rate, loudness, noise, speech, and difficult passages.
guide_stages.prompt: Analyze the bound audio and record its technical and perceptual baseline.

guide_stages.label: Plan conservative cleanup
guide_stages.detail: Choose bounded processing and representative passages for comparison.
guide_stages.prompt: Plan conservative cleanup with an original-versus-cleaned fidelity comparison.

guide_stages.label: Create the cleaned revision
guide_stages.detail: Process the audio, preserve the original, and inspect artifacts and damaged speech.
guide_stages.prompt: Create or revise the cleaned audio and report measured and listening evidence.

guide_stages.label: Verify cleanup fidelity
guide_stages.detail: Listen to the complete result and verify intelligibility, loudness, peaks, and duration.
guide_stages.prompt: Assess cleanup fidelity and identify any full listening review still required.

templates.label: Tighten silence
templates.description: Shorten selected pauses while retaining meaningful delivery timing.

guide_stages.label: Define the pacing goal
guide_stages.detail: Bind the source and describe where pacing feels slow without requiring blanket removal.
guide_stages.prompt: Review the pacing goal and bound source for this silence-tightening workflow.

guide_stages.label: Identify meaningful pauses
guide_stages.detail: Distinguish dead air from pauses supporting comprehension, emotion, humor, or action.
guide_stages.prompt: Analyze pauses in the bound source and preserve meaningful delivery timing.

guide_stages.label: Plan pause changes
guide_stages.detail: Record exact candidate ranges, retained context, padding, and timing consequences.
guide_stages.prompt: Prepare a reversible pause-tightening plan with exact source ranges.

guide_stages.label: Create the tightened revision
guide_stages.detail: Apply reviewed changes and recalculate transcript, graphic, caption, and sound timing.
guide_stages.prompt: Create or revise the tightened output and verify its rendered time mapping.

guide_stages.label: Review pacing and continuity
guide_stages.detail: Listen through every changed boundary and the complete delivery at normal speed.
guide_stages.prompt: Assess pacing, speech continuity, synchronization, and remaining listening review.

templates.label: Thumbnail
templates.description: Develop truthful thumbnail options for a selected source or finished revision.

guide_stages.label: Define the packaging promise
guide_stages.detail: Bind the relevant source or revision and clarify audience, title context, and identity.
guide_stages.prompt: Review this thumbnail workflow's bound media and define an accurate packaging promise.

guide_stages.label: Find truthful visual evidence
guide_stages.detail: Identify the actual outcome, subject, emotion, and usable source imagery.
guide_stages.prompt: Inspect the bound media for truthful thumbnail concepts and source limitations.

guide_stages.label: Plan distinct concepts
guide_stages.detail: Choose readable hierarchy, crop, expression, text restraint, and brand treatment.
guide_stages.prompt: Plan a small set of distinct, truthful thumbnail concepts for this workflow.

guide_stages.label: Create thumbnail revisions
guide_stages.detail: Produce inspectable variants with provenance and preserve prior successful versions.
guide_stages.prompt: Create or revise the approved thumbnail concepts and record their provenance.

guide_stages.label: Review at viewing size
guide_stages.detail: Check readability, crop, identity, factual promise, and exact finished-video alignment.
guide_stages.prompt: Assess the actual thumbnail variants at intended viewing size without authorizing publication.
